input: As a dishroom worker, you carefully lift the parts box from the shelving unit at the press station, then proceed to carry it to the designated storage area, and finally, lower the box onto a pallet, which is already positioned next to the bin of rags and cleaning supplies, ready for processing.

As a packaging worker at the shipping dock, you push the forklift towards the loading bay, followed by carefully navigating it around the other crates and boxes until it reaches the designated area next to the parts box, then skillfully lift the box using the forklift's hydraulic arm, pushed the box onto a pallet, and finally secured it with straps before transporting it out of the dock.

As a packaging worker, I arrive at the shipping dock and rotate the plate rack on its axis to ensure stability, then carefully lift it off the pallet, followed by rotating the rack again to align its horizontal bars with the shipping container's interior dimensions, and next position the rack against the container's sides, finally securing it in place before moving on to package the shipment.

As a punch press operator, I carefully push the heavy parts box onto the designated storage rack to organize the workspace, then followed by pushing the box's lid open and removing it to inspect for any damaged parts that required special attention, and finally, after verifying all parts were secure, I pushed the box back into place at the press station, where it was secured with bungee cords.

As a punch press operator, she lifts the 50-pound parts box off the stainless steel shelving unit in the dishwashing area, then carefully navigates it to the designated spot near the workstation where she places it on a steel pallet, followed by the need to lift again when she needs additional parts from the box, and finally uses her upper body strength to hoist the now-empty box onto a storage dolly with wheels designed for heavy-duty transport.
